Cross-stack concept-review fixes (`1a 2a 3a 4a`, keeping `auto off` so it stops at `ship-review`):
1. Decouple `play_many` from hardcoded `processes=1` (`1a`, `3a`): in `resources.py` (`place()`), stop short-circuiting `if streaming:` to `processes=1` / `bus="local"`. Route `play_many` through the same `_select_inference(loader, checkpoints)` and `Agents.devices` placement as `play`: on CUDA/Metal with multiple CPUs, spawn multi-process game workers sharing 1 GPU agent (`SocketForwardBus` today, ready for `fddc05` `ShmForwardBus` underneath) so multi-core RTX 4090 / M4 Max throughput is preserved (18k+ g/h instead of regressing to ~4-5k); use `LocalForwardBus` (in-process zero-copy thread + dataclass traversal) whenever `processes == 1` or direct CPU mode. Do NOT add a `workers=1` knob (`3a`).
2. Delete the 2-phase `for streaming in (False, True): run_phase(...)` split in `run.py` so mixed `play` + `play_many` groups share one GPU agent process in one phase and load each checkpoint once.
3. Match `EXP-77` on fair-share `Take(count)` grant capping (`min(requested, max(1, math.ceil(len(each.pending) / processes)))` in `run.py`, `2a`) and drop `1 if inference == "metal"` in `resources.py` (`4a`) so `async def play` on Metal uses `ceil(max_batch / processes)` coroutines like CUDA.
4. Keep `ForwardBus`, `_FlightBook`, `Flight`, `LocalForwardBus`, `@dataclass` zero-copy traversal (`1829a6e`), and single-owner `Placement` intact. Update tests/docs, verify full tests/mypy/ruff green, and republish PR #153 to `ship-review`.
